summary: Added meterbill/money.py with all rounding rules, routed every module through it, removed the decimal context line, and kept batch's worker-thread behaviour (half-even band charges and per-kWh price, via keyword-only parameters) while other paths stay half-up; fuzzed CLI output matches the original. Left as-is and not fixed: batch rounds band charges half-even while bill/quote round half-up; also 28-digit context precision rounding of plain arithmetic is no longer half-up (only matters for inputs over 28 digits).
